search_knowledge.text:
# checkout runbook

The synchronous order pipeline. Calls cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, payment, then email, in order. Implemented in Go. Owned by the checkout team (PD-CHECKOUT, #astroshop-checkout).

## When this fires

checkout is on the customer-facing critical path. A failure here surfaces on frontend, frontend-proxy as elevated errors or latency, often before a checkout alert fires. If you were paged for one of those and the cause is not obvious there, check checkout early.

## Thresholds

| Signal | Objective | Page at |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Availability (28d) | 99.5% | error budget 50% burned in 1h |
| Duration p95 | < 1200 ms | > 1800 ms for 5m |
| Duration p99 | < 2500 ms | > 3750 ms for 5m |

## Dashboards and queries

Grafana: the checkout row on the Astroshop service dashboard. The queries behind that row, for pasting straight into Prometheus:

promql

# error ratio (span metrics)

sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))

/ sum(rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="checkout", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m]))

# p95 duration, ms (span metrics)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="checkout", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER"}[5m])))

# rpc_server_call_duration_seconds p95

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="checkout"}

search_knowledge.text:
[inc 2607 payment paymentfailure > INC-2607: payment returning errors > Action items]
1. Add a Grafana annotation and a low-urgency alert on `flagd_flag_evaluations_total` deltas, so a flag flip is visible on every dashboard. *(owner: platform-eng)*
2. Add "check the dependency graph before the service that paged" as step 1 of the `checkout` runbook. *(owner: checkout)* — done, see `knowledge/runbook/checkout.md`.
3. Confirm the `payment` runbook's known-failure-modes section lists `paymentFailure` with this signature. *(owner: checkout)*

search_knowledge.text:
[dependency failure playbook > Dependency-failure playbook > If `checkout` is down]
**Customer-facing impact: yes**, via `frontend`, `frontend-proxy`. Expect the first page to land on one of those, not on `checkout` — see that service's own runbook for its specific symptom, and `checkout`'s runbook for the actual fix.
